rca_of_the_issue: The prior failure was caused by the mobile grid/main content expanding to intrinsic child width, which made the mobile header row effectively wider than the viewport. The added min-width:0 and overflow-x:hidden constraints now keep the shell/header aligned to the 390px viewport, so the logo remains centered and the page no longer horizontally scrolls.
